name: Amisk Lake Recreation Site - Sawmill Bay Campground

fees.note: Self-registration, first come, first served. Sask Parks' 2026-27 fee table charges an unserviced site $18 (economy) or $20 (non-electrical) a night, taxes included; which class this campground is isn't published. Its electric sites are the table's $35. AWH 2026-10-12: 'For the 6 SK sites you might as well just say $18-$20.'
